senses.zh_definition: 斯特里克兰：英语姓氏，也见于相关地名；在马来语中按专有名词使用。
senses.en_definition: An English habitational surname, also occurring in place names.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang berasal daripada nama tempat; turut terdapat dalam nama tempat dan digunakan sebagai kata nama khas.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 表示专有名词。输入键保留小写，正文中的姓氏应写作 Strickland。没有证据将其列为具有普通词义的官方马来语词条，故 status 为 unverified；马来语释义是编写说明。以下是常规姓名搭配，不是语料频率结论。姓氏来源依据：[《Dictionary of American Family Names》释义转载](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/strickland)。

etymology.historical_story: Strickland preserves a rural English landscape in a family name. The surname derives from places in historic Westmorland, including Great and Little Strickland. Their names combine Old English stīrc, a young bullock or heifer, with land. The agricultural meaning belongs to the place-name's history, rather than describing people who bear the surname. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/strickland).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Strickland 记成一个完整姓氏；可用历史上的小牛牧地帮助联想，但不能把姓名直译为牧牛地。
